name: AIAAIC Repository
aliases: AI, Algorithmic, and Automation Incidents and Controversies

homonyms.basis: No homonym on the rail: every card is on the AIAAIC Repository. The MMRS record for this entity has no disambiguation field; the AI Incident Database's record disambiguates the AIAAIC from the AIID by 'AIAAIC, controversies, algorithmic and automation' (MMRS-30). Distinct entities kept as relations, never senses of the name: AIAAIC, the initiative that keeps the repository (its operator; the acronym is both the organisation's name and the repository's prefix); AIAAIC Alert, its newsletter; the neighbours in the harm basin, the AI Incident Database and the OECD AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor.

captures.description: THE AIAAIC REPOSITORY, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'an independent, open-access public database that tracks real-world incidents, controversies, and harms related to artificial intelligence, algorithms, and automation'; started June 2019 as a private initiative; a scope from discrimination to chatbot hallucinations; CC BY-SA 4.0; used by researchers, journalists, civil society and policymakers. Three cards: the repository, its OECD catalogue entry, EthicAI.
